usedFor: Each “New Order” in AutoQuote3D saves its file into a Dropbox folder.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in AutoQuote3D, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: Each placed order gets its file saved to a chosen folder, ready for production.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” takes files only from a public web link, so the order must supply one.
